==Usage==
Place <nowiki>{{FortniteSummary}}</nowiki> before the "Plot summary" section of a game in ''[[Fortnite]]''.

The template defaults to ''Fortnite''. Use the format <nowiki>{{FortniteSummary|ABBREVIATION}}</nowiki> for a specific game mode.

*<code>FNBR</code> &ndash; ''[[Fortnite Battle Royale]]''
*<code>LFNO</code> &ndash; ''[[LEGO Fortnite Odyssey]]''
*<code>LFNBL</code> &ndash; ''[[LEGO Fortnite Brick Life]]''
